plugins.name: cctabs
plugins.description: Claude Code tab manager. Terminal tabs as the UI, no tmux. Claude can orchestrate its own sibling sessions.

plugins.name: browser-automation
plugins.description: Browser automation for Claude Code. Persistent Chrome profile, CDP connection.

plugins.name: mytranscriber
plugins.description: Turn recordings into text on this computer with My Transcriber (https://mytranscriber.app): voice memos, meetings, interviews, podcasts, lectures, dictation, any audio or video file, and finding what was said in recordings already transcribed.

plugins.name: review-md
plugins.description: Markdown → one self-contained styled HTML file (and a sane PDF). Build-time mermaid→inline-SVG, glyph callouts, footnote-integrity checking, dark mode, print stylesheet, doc packs, and an --artifact mode for Claude Artifacts.

plugins.name: revenueassistant
plugins.description: Companion skill that hands the customer, deal and pipeline work you raise in Claude Code to The Revenue Assistant app on your computer, once you say OK. Needs The Revenue Assistant app and service, installed separately.

plugins.name: revenuemagnet
plugins.description: Build it, and they will come: "it" being the growth system around your product. Revenue Magnet maps everyone around your product from your own mail, calendar and analytics, and drafts the next part to build. This companion skill hands the growth work you raise in Claude Code to the app, once you say OK; the app is installed separately.

plugins.name: mindmymoney
plugins.description: Ask Claude Code where your money went, what a PayPal or Klarna line was, or which subscriptions and bills to deal with, and this companion skill hands it to the Mind My Money app on your computer. Needs the Mind My Money app, installed separately.

plugins.name: clerkai
plugins.description: Companion skill that hands the accounting prep you raise in Claude Code (closing a month, finding receipts, what to send your accountant) to the Clerk.AI (clerkai.eu) app on your computer. Needs the Clerk.AI app, installed separately.

plugins.name: rememberthis
plugins.description: Ask Claude Code for a month of your life or a chapter of your life story, and the Remember This app writes it from the photos, voice memos and notes on your Mac. Ask who mattered in a year, or when you were somewhere, and Claude answers from the app's index. Companion skill: needs the Remember This app, installed separately.
